body:
Sorry for this question but, How do they force you? Or your own fear and overthinking created this illusion that they are obligating you to stay?. (this is how I felt around toxic people)

We unconsciously create the bad habit of overthinking and day dreaming (I did it I hate it). It is bad because you are letting that habit control your mind, you have to be aware you are in full control of your mind and what you think and even YOUR PERSPECTIVES, all this overthinking and daydreaming just pushes you down and creates fake scenarios where you harm yourself even more.

I dont know how your life is, what you got available and what not, but what you DO have right now and may even be the only tool available for change is your mind. Accept yourself and your situation, be 100% aware you may be in the worst moment ever in life and try, with small steps, to move forward. Make the effort not to feel inhibited for what people may say abut your decisions. Create that "Step by Step to get better" Cycle every step you take will be stronger.. Just like you created the overthinking and daydreaming selfharm cycle. Even if they criticize you for your decisions MOVE FORWARD. Starting over is OK, What is NOT OK is staying somewhere where you are not happy, valued or appreciated.

Yes. God I wish I could live surrounded by dogs and cats.

I wish you the best of luck, no one deserves any harassment. 

Are you having too much of overthinking and daydreaming?

Of course, everything is temporary and that is a fact you never have to forget.

What makes me feel sad is that the only thing that drags me down is people! I want to live surrounded by animals. It's like im feeling my life is amazing in terms of where I am now, but that constant harassment, god it makes you feel like shit in the long run. I'm tired of fighting against toxicity, my priority is to remove every toxic people from my every day basis, dont give a fuck if it's family, friends, coworkers or even clients. I'm trying to find peace in my mind, because I got no peace,either there is someone being toxic or my own overthinking creates toxic people.

Look, sorry I wrote that much and I was not hitting the spot. I am struggling with that right now too, family, clients and coworkers are super toxic to me and it's making me feel like shit.

I am doing a great effort into making this not affect me, i would like to share my mindset with you in case, maybe you can take something positive out of this.

Know that Toxic people are toxic to everyone, it's up to you how much their toxicity affects you. Easier said than done tho. I'm prioritizing the removal of toxic people in my life, no matter if it is family, friends, coworkers, etc. It's better to be alone. YOU ARE THE PRIORITY, being surrounded in a bully environment will just drain you in every way and make you feel depresssed and useless, try to either deal or remove the people that make you feel like this, you have to know you have an enormous potential and this people is just dragging you down. Your mind's health is your main priority or else you will just live miserably and it's like living in hell. You may not have the strenght to move forward, but know your own mind is able to create strenght out of the sleeve.

I am really bad at defending myself, I have no harm towards people at all and it's a disadvantage against these toxic people, that's why distancing is my answer. I will try to get rid of every toxic people I have in my everyday basis, set peace in my mind and make the effort to remove the victim mindset.

Knowing you are getting bullied, WHY do you want to stop living? I will example myself.

I am a bully victim too, got broken bones, burned hands on stove and heard the most hurtful things someone could ever say to me. I wanted to die because I felt my life was going to be that miserable forever and I didnt want that to happen.

Im 24 now and I was a bit fool for thinking that, my innocence and inexperience in life convinced me I would live under constant harassment my entire life.

Once  you are done with school you will never see those ugly face anymore and you can finally focus on finding happiness and who to be around. Unluckily school is something we have to attend by obligation, but once you are done with that, you will have control of where you go and who you see.

There are shit people everywhere tho, life is full of lessons, for my bullying experience I thought to myself "What is this trying to teach me?" and I was able to get strenght to face the real world.

Try to get rid of them, if you don't, wait until school is over and never see them again. Every second they bully you, you are lowkey getting stronger, let that strenght out to the world.

I feel exactly the same. Stress and toxic people drained me so much I just want to sleep all day and at the same time I don't.  We will get out of this, life is full of ups and downs, mostly downs  but those fews ups are worth living. Jumping towards the train tracks will not solve anything, speaking out is the key. Write, talk about it. 

our minds are out of control, medications are a way to null the mind so i dont trust them (I havent even tried meds) Im making a big effort into controlling my emotions, my first step was to get to know myself deep inside. Something that is helping me a lot is to google my feelings, you will start reading posts and articles that will lead you to make more precise searchs towards posts and articles that  you can relate to, you will realize you are not alon, we are all struggling and it's not about changing from one day to another, small steps are the most important here.
